function.description:
Retrieves the site-specific variable values assigned for a rule (`ruleId`) of a rule-based compliance (RBC) policy (`policyId`) at a given site (`siteId`). Use this when the user asks for the variable values assigned to a site for a compliance/RBC policy. Resolve `policyId` from the policy name (api_getCompliancePolicies), `siteId` from the site name (api_getSites), and `ruleId` from api_getComplianceRules first.

Variable values are inherited. A site that has no directly assigned values uses the values of the nearest ancestor site that does, so pass `_inherited=true` whenever the user asks which values apply at a site. Omit it only when the user specifically asks whether values are set directly on that site, that is, whether the site overrides its parent.

Read the response as follows:
- `variableValues` present with no `inheritedSiteName`: the values are assigned directly on the requested site.
- `variableValues` present together with `inheritedSiteName`: the values apply to the requested site but come from the named ancestor site. Say where they come from, for example "inherited from Global".
- No `variableValues`, only `inheritedSiteId` and `inheritedSiteName`: the site has no values of its own and the call was made without `_inherited=true`. Retry with `_inherited=true` rather than telling the user that no variable values are set.

Always obtain `siteId` from api_getSites by site name, including for the Global site. Name the ancestor site in your answer using `inheritedSiteName`. `inheritedSiteId` is an internal marker rather than a resolvable site id, so never show it to the user, never pass it to api_getSites, and never reuse it as the `siteId` of a later call.
function.name: api_getComplianceVariableAssignment

_inherited.description: Set to `true` when the user asks which variable values apply at a site, so that values inherited from an ancestor site are returned when the site has none of its own. Leave unset (default `false`) only when the user explicitly asks whether values are assigned directly at that site.

ruleId.description: The `id` of the rule within the compliance policy.

siteId.description: The `id` of the site to which compliance policy is associated.

variableValues.description: An array of variable value assignments.

values.description: List of variable values. The order of the list is preserved for compliance checks.

items.description: The variable value is formatted as a string. It must be a valid string representation of the data and conform to the specified type. For variables with an input type of `SINGLE_SELECT` or `MULTI_SELECT`, pass the actual value, not the key.

inheritedSiteId.description: The Site Id of the site that this setting is inherited from.

inheritedSiteName.description: The name of the site that this setting is inherited from.

response.description: The payload containing variable value assignments.
response.title: VariableValuesPayload
